plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fix track duration displayed incorrectly before playback starts. Duration was being passed as a string like "3:45" instead of seconds (225). Now correctly converts from YouTube's minutes:seconds format to seconds for LMS. Thanks to Paul Webster.
